leakage_assessment.compliant_path: Fit Wt/Wv only on images/prompts outside every formal CV-Bench manifest, freeze the projection, then run the single final CV-Bench evaluation once.
leakage_assessment.input_and_prompt_leakage: yes if CV-Bench images/prompts are used: Wt/Wv would be fit to the evaluation inputs, and the config selects the best epoch on a val split that is itself part of the formal eval set.
leakage_assessment.label_leakage: none: the extractor/trainer never read the ground-truth answers or choices; the teacher target is a model-derived saliency soft-target.
leakage_assessment.reason_observed_false: No extraction cache, no index and no Wt/Wv exist (artifacts/token_selector/prompt_projection_features absent; no prompt_projection_WtWv.npz). No training or selection has run.
leakage_assessment.reason_prospective_true: The only documented extraction command uses the formal 64-token CV-Bench pilot100 manifest. Replaying the config split on that source puts every train/val/test image in the formal CV-Bench set (limit-4 subset: 11/11 train, 2/2 val, 3/3 test images overlap pilot100; no-limit: 69/69 train, 15/15 val, 16/16 test). Any CV-Bench manifest as source gives 100% image overlap.

transductive_vs_inductive.internal_split_claim: The config's internal train/val/test disjointness only prevents self-leakage within the distillation pool; it does not establish external independence from CV-Bench.
transductive_vs_inductive.strict_inductive: VIOLATED by the documented plan: the projection's train and val images/prompts must be disjoint from every formal CV-Bench eval image/prompt. They are not.
transductive_vs_inductive.transductive_unlabeled: The teacher uses unlabeled dense-model saliency, so a transductive protocol could in principle reuse eval inputs, but then (a) no eval image may influence epoch/hyperparameter selection, (b) the result must be reported as transductive and cannot be the headline inductive number, and (c) the internal 'test' split is no longer an independent generalization estimate. This requires explicit PI authorization and is not what the config/report claims.

warnings: The config does not pin the extraction manifest; provenance depends on the operator command. This is the root governance gap.
The documented command (screening100_budget64_diagnostic) is formal CV-Bench evaluation material; running it as-is creates contamination.
Internal image-hash grouping cannot detect external eval-set overlap; use it only for internal disjointness.
COCO identity must be matched by coco_image_id, not raw image SHA256 (resized copies differ).
The extraction source gap means the claim 'test evaluated once after freeze' is misleading when the internal pool is a subset of the formal eval set.
CURRENT_STATUS has a stale older bullet describing 'split by sample_id hash'; the frozen code splits by source_image_sha256.
